findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:126 defines `Submodule.linearMap_eq_iff_of_span_eq_top`; lines 187–202 rebuild the same argument through two manually constructed `MultilinearMap`s.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Graded/Insertion.lean:154 defines `MultilinearMap.oneSlot`, line 163 proves `oneSlot_apply`, and line 234 defines `Fin.oneSlotEquiv`; Algebra.lean:329–351 manually reimplements that composition.

summary: Two proofs rederive existing Mathlib/TauCeti extension and multilinear-composition machinery.
